<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תשרי_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518914243_theRebbe_128" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_A9_D7_A8_D7_99_meluket__BH_POST_1766518914243_theRebbe_128__p005">
  <section v="12">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Based on the above, the fact that taking the Four Species causes even the nations to praise G-d for Israel's victory is a higher level than the victory itself, representing a new development and the completion of the purpose of a dwelling place in the lowest of low.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">And based on all the above, it is understood,</t>
    <t s="2">that this—that through taking the Four Species, they cause that even the nations etc. will agree to the victory of Israel, to the point that they will praise and extol G-d for this—</t>
    <t s="3">is superior</t>
    <t s="4">(in one particular aspect)</t>
    <t s="5">to the victory itself.</t>
    <t s="6">For this—that even the nations,</t>
    <t s="7">and particularly those who were initially opponents</t>
    <t s="8">(and it was necessary to defeat them),</t>
    <t s="9">praise and extol G-d for this, that His kindness has prevailed over us—</t>
    <t s="10">is a matter of renewal</t>
    <t s="11">(in the manner explained above in section 7),</t>
    <t s="12">in addition to this, that through this the intention of a dwelling place in the lower realms is completed,</t>
    <t s="13">in the lowest realm, beneath which there is no lower.</t>
    <t s="14">And although this matter</t>
    <t s="15">(the nullification of the nations to Israel)</t>
    <t s="16">will primarily be in the future to come,</t>
    <t s="17">as it is stated in the prophecy of Zechariah73</t>
    <t s="18">that each Jew will have two thousand eight hundred servants</t>
    <t s="19">(from the nations of the world)</t>
    <t s="20">who will hold the four corners of his tallis,</t>
    <t s="21">nevertheless, a foretaste of this exists even in the time of exile,</t>
    <t s="22">and particularly in the time close to the coming of Moshiach</t>
    <t s="23">(as above, section 5).</t>
  </section>
  <section v="13">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This explains "And you shall take for yourselves on the first day, first in reckoning," because the effect of causing the nations to praise is a new matter, distinct from the victory revealed on Rosh HaShanah.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And this is [the meaning of] "And you shall take for yourselves on the first day, first in reckoning,"</t>
    <t s="1">for although the revelation of the victory of Israel through taking the Four Species is the revelation of the victory that was on Rosh HaShanah, and this matter—that taking the Four Species on the festival of Sukkos relates to this, as it is the fifteenth day from Rosh HaShanah—</t>
    <t s="2">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="3">this—that through taking the Four Species they cause the nations to agree to the victory of Israel, to the point that they will praise and extol G-d for this—is a new matter,</t>
    <t s="4">and therefore it says "And you shall take for yourselves on the first day,"</t>
    <t s="5">first in reckoning.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="14">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Based on this, the Sages' statement that for three "firsts" they merited three "firsts" is explained, and the "first" of the Four Species is superior to that of Sukkah because through the work of the Four Species, the essential purpose of a dwelling place for Atzmus is completed, yielding the reward of the revelation of Atzmus.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And based on this, we can explain what our Sages said,74</t>
    <t s="1">"In reward for three 'firsts'</t>
    <t s="2">[the rest of the foot on Pesach, the rest of the foot on the festival [of Sukkos], and the taking of the lulav75]</t>
    <t s="3">they merited three 'firsts':</t>
    <t s="4">to cut off the seed of Eisav, for the building of the Beis HaMikdash, and for the name of Moshiach."</t>
    <t s="5">And it is known76</t>
    <t s="6">that the aspect of "first" of the Four Species is superior to the aspect of "first" of Sukkah,77</t>
    <t s="7">for seemingly,</t>
    <t s="8">since the matter of the Four Species is the drawing down of the encompassing light of the Sukkah</t>
    <t s="9">(in inwardness),</t>
    <t s="10">how is it possible that they should be superior to the Sukkah?</t>
    <t s="11">The explanation of this can be said,</t>
    <t s="12">for through the service of the Four Species, Israel complete the intention that the Holy One, blessed be He, desired to have a dwelling place for Him in the lower realms,</t>
    <t s="13">and therefore,</t>
    <t s="14">also the reward that comes to them through this is the revelation of the Awtsmoos.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
